results.title: Morocco believes it has won race to host 2030 World Cup final
results.content:
Morocco believes it has won the race to host the next World Cup final.
 
The 2030 tournament is being held in Spain, Portugal and Morocco with three opening games in South America.
 
The final will be in the Bernabeu Stadium in Madrid or the Hassan II Stadium in Benslimane, near Casablanca.
 
FIFA says no decision has been made yet on the final venue for the final but the president of the Moroccan Football Federations has claimed it will be in his country.
